title: HCLTech style · Aptitude + Computer basics
description: Four equal sections including computer fundamentals. 60 MCQs in 60 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

In what ratio must rice at Rs 24/kg be mixed with rice at Rs 72/kg so that the mixture costs Rs 64/kg?
The price of an item is first increased by 10% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net percentage change in its price?
questions.explanation: Net factor = (1 + 10/100)(1 - 20/100) = 22/25, so the change is -12%: a 12% decrease.

questions.text: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 7:5. After 4 years, the ratio will be 25:19. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 7x and 5x. (7x+4)/(5x+4) = 25/19 gives x = 3; A = 21.

questions.text: Asha is 21st from the left and 20th from the right in a row. How many people are in the row?
Yash walks 12 m towards the East, then turns right and walks 5 m, then turns right and walks 12 m. How far is Yash from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Net displacement: 0 m east and 5 m south; distance = √(0² + 5²) = 5 m.

questions.text: A man is facing North. He turns right, then turns left, then turns about. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: Right = 90° clockwise, left = 90° anticlockwise, about = 180°. Final direction: South.
